nodes.text: The phone rings. Ben moves to answer it, but Emily gives him a look that could freeze fire.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We're in the middle of something. If you answer that, I won't be coming to your Sectionals game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You know how important that game is to me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I would. Because `this` is that important, Ben. You need to have a relationship with `your` dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: I would. Because [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is that important, Ben. You need to have a relationship with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] dad.

nodes.text: Ben doesn't hesitate. He answers the phone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's up, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm so glad you answered! I know we're not best friends or anything, but I'm in a bind! I'm having trouble with Sam, she--
Emily reaches over and snatches the phone out of Ben's hand.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do all boys not understand girls? Tell her the truth, you idiot!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And stop calling! Ben and I are either on a very romantic date, or we're about to be arrested for public disturbance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Time. Will. Tell.
Emily hangs up. She and Ben stare at each other, neither backing down.
He has failed.
Nick and Sam might never know what would have happened if Nick had kept up the lie, but that doesn't mean `you` won't!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just don't want to talk about this right now, Emily. We might say something we'll regret.
Ben goes right on arguing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, then maybe I don't need you!
The hurt immediately registers on Emily's face.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You don't mean that... But I know one thing. You need me `a lot more` than I need you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't mean that... But I know one thing. You need me [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot more[/i][/color] than I need you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that so?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Will you excuse me for a minute? I need to run to the restroom real quick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.
Sam walks out of the shop toward some nearby restrooms. The shopkeep comes out of the backroom, tears in her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I heard everything. How could you? How could you, Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Listen, it's more complicated than you think.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Aha! Then it is love!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: To be honest, I don't know anymore...
Nick steps out of the shop. He takes out his phone and calls Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I bet things are going a lot better for Ben...
You are now playing as Ben...
And he's in the middle of a fight with Emily!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! They're not!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They're not the same thing at all!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How is talking to `my` father any easier than talking to yours?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How is talking to [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] father any easier than talking to yours?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because your father's actually around!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What difference does it make?! Just to refresh your memory... My dad isn't exactly Mr. Sunshine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least if I had to talk to him, I'd know what I was getting! I'd know how to deal with it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's `a lot` harder to have a serious conversation with a stranger!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] harder to have a serious conversation with a stranger!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're being `way` too dramatic about this! Your dad isn't a stranger, Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too dramatic about this! Your dad isn't a stranger, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All I'm asking is that you sit down and have a talk with him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know what you're asking, but I think it's a bad idea!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because! My dad and I `don't` talk. I go to school. He goes to work. That's the way it's always been!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because! My dad and I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] talk. I go to school. He goes to work. That's the way it's always been!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Which is exactly the problem!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stop pretending like you know me so well! You know me now, but you don't know what I've been through!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know you? I know you, Ben. I know this bothers you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Leave. It. Alone.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No! I'm not going to let this slide. I'm not going to give it the Kale treatment.
Ben feels the fury of his anger rising up inside him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? It sounded pretty romantic to me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's, uh, that's probably because you've got Valentine's on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I totally see how you could misinterpret it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about 'All I ask, I ask for you, this Valentine's?'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That... That `sounds` very romantic. But, uh, it actually just means I'd like you with me on Valentine's.
nodes.text_bbcode: That... That [color=#e23b3b][i]sounds[/i][/color] very romantic. But, uh, it actually just means I'd like you with me on Valentine's.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Cause that's not romantic.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As friends! I meant because without you, you know, I might be thinking about how I'm alone on Valentine's... Which sucks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, it does.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, cool. I guess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The 'you' is actually Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So 'the rocky times?'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, past Valentine's Days.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And crossing unbreakable lines?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know... I was just looking for a rhyme.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't even rhyme.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It would rhyme in a rap song.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about 'what we have, it must be real,' and the whole strong steel bit?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was being ironic, since I hate Valentine's so much. Such a dumb day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then I guess I don't get Anti-Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought it was supposed to be a fun way of spending time together on Valentine's Day as friends.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It... It is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, whatever this was, it sucked.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll show you.
Nick picks up a piece of chocolate and unceremoniously tosses it at Sam's face! It grazes her cheek and skitters across the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! You little twerp!
She flashes Nick a devilish smile as she picks up a nearby piece of chocolate from among the samples and throws it at Nick. It ricochets off his glasses!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know what this means, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate war!
In a flash, Nick and Sam both snatch up handfuls of the chocolate, peppering each other with them!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait! Cease fire! Cease fire!
Sam stops. Her arm poised to throw another piece.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're... We're kind of creating a mess here...
Nick gestures to the shopkeeper who is giving them an angry look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...
Sam lowers her arm.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: End the cease fire!
Nick tosses a handful of chocolate pieces at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You cheater!
As Sam whirls to go on the offensive, she catches a chocolate piece right in her mouth! Both of them immediately stop, their eyes wide!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha! No way! Did that just happen?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmm-hmmf! It torary did!
Nick puts a hand on Sam's shoulder, trying to brace himself from laughing too hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Nick quickly removes his hand. Sam leans back away from him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, uh, hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I just got a call from Taylor. She needs to meet up with me about funding for the theater department.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I think I have to bail on Anti-Valentine's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Life of a Social Chair!
$ZOE gives both Nick and Sam quick hugs goodbye and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That was sudden.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE's been like that lately. One minute she's here, the next she's gone.
The shopkeeper comes over and starts to sweep up Nick and Sam's mess.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, we're sorry. We got a little carried away. We'll clean it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And we'll reimburse you for it!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: What's the point of throwing chocolate?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick and I just got a little carried away!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Wait! Wait! Wait! `You're` Nick?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! Wait! Wait! [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no! I forgot to cancel the order!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: When I saw the love note you left for your true love, Samantha, I couldn't help myself!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I read it to all the girls who work here! And when I finished reading it, they all sighed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's a love note?

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: You must be Samantha! Oh my goodness!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll go get the note... And my camera!
The shopkeeper scurries off, still talking from the backroom.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: And my scrapbook!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does this note say?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's not what you think!
The shopkeeper returns holding a box of chocolates, with a note attached to it.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Can I read it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think that's really neces--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. Read it. Definitely read it.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Okay...
The shopkeeper's hands shake as she unfolds the note and gently clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'My dear Samantha...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Though I've taken you through rocky times...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Though I've walked across unbreakable lines...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'What we have, it must be real...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Stronger than the strongest steel.'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'So all I ask, I ask for you, this Valentine's.'
The shopkeeper lets out a satisfied sigh.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll leave you two alone.
She takes a picture of Nick and Sam and then leaves, singing softly, a beaming smile across her face.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got `a lot` of explaining to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've got [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of explaining to do!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's really not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really? 'Cause I `think` you wrote me a love poem and attached it to some chocolates!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? 'Cause I [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] you wrote me a love poem and attached it to some chocolates!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's exactly it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not exactly it.

nodes.text: Then `what` exactly is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] exactly is it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... It isn't a love poem.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds fun, but I don't understand... Won't that be really hard with the blindfolds on?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... We should at least try it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That could be fun!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah!
The shopkeeper sets out an assortment of chocolate samples...
Nick wraps his sweater over his eyes, and Sam does the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is stupid.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Or not...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it's stupid.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I'll throw first...
Nick reaches out in front of him, trying to find a chocolate piece.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How long do I have to sit here with my mouth open like an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not long. Sorry.
Nick grabs a piece of chocolate...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here we go! Three! Two! One!
He tosses it blindly into the air!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! You bounced that off of my head!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I admit it. The blindfolds are a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But the throwing isn't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll throw first.
Nick grabs a handful of chocolates.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready!
He tosses a chocolate into the air...
And Sam catches it in her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My turn to throw!
Sam takes a chocolate from the display and tosses it up for Nick...
It goes over his head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fail!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On who?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: On you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No way! That was not a catchable chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not for an amateur catcher such as yourself.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Amateur?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, let me get this straight... Your alternative to us wearing blindfolds and hand feeding each other chocolate is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Us wearing blindfolds and hand feeding each other chocolate?

nodes.text: Getting rid of the blindfolds?

nodes.text: Think about it... It's `so` Valentine's it becomes Anti-Valentine's!
nodes.text_bbcode: Think about it... It's [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] Valentine's it becomes Anti-Valentine's!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, no. I don't think it works that way. And did you not hear me talk about vomiting two seconds ago?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, but this time, no blindfolds!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I get it. Now I'll be able to see myself vomiting.

nodes.text: No, miss! No vomiting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, lady! I am `not` going to vomit in your store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Relax, lady! I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to vomit in your store!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not unless he tries to jam his warm, chocolate-y fingers into my mouth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Got it...

nodes.text: You know what we could do instead?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that? And it better be a lot smarter than your last idea...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kind of crazy, but we could still hand feed each other!

nodes.text: But we...

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll be with you in just a moment...

nodes.text: Chocolate. Paradise. Must. Eat. All.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think this place broke Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so!

nodes.text: So... You're sure you're okay with me tagging along?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I had to ask!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Like I said on the way over, it's okay. Of course you can be here. It's not like this is a date!

nodes.text: Oooh! Look! Chocolate marshmallow rabbits!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Would you like to try a sample?

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Nick

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: This is `way` better than what I had originally planned. No box of chocolates. No love note. No obvious romance.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] better than what I had originally planned. No box of chocolates. No love note. No obvious romance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, how do we anti-Valentine's this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I think if this were a proper date, we'd hand feed each other chocolate samples while blindfolded.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I didn't think it was possible to want to vomit inside a chocolate shop.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Please, miss, go outside if you're going to--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry! Just an expression!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess the anti-Valentine's version of this means we...

nodes.text: Yes, but I also know my cousin. You're clever, Sam. And having me come along ensures that you don't risk getting hurt.

nodes.text: Face it. You want me along because if I'm there, it's definitely not a date.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's... That's not true at all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: No! But I `am` saying that I'll come along... Just let me finish putting on my make-up.

nodes.text: That's true... You do smell like you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's here, right?

nodes.text: Yes, and he looks... `Good.`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? That's weird. Does that mean I'm underdressed?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we both are. Are you sure I should come to this thing?

nodes.text: He's picking you up, he looks nice, and you're nervous. It `feels` an awful lot like a date.

nodes.text: We're just friends, $ZOE! Nothing's going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.text: Come on! He practically painted the lines of the friend zone with this Anti-Valentine's thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But don't you think it's another sign that your fortune's going to come true?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're still going on about Madame Fortuna's fortune? That was like three months ago!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But she said you'd find love on a Friday between February 8th and February 15th!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She also said there'd be sparks! Have you seen any sparks this week?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! Everywhere!
Earlier that week...
Sam and $ZOE walk by a construction site just as a bandsaw goes to work on a piece of metal. The sparks fly out!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Later that week...
They're walking through the mall when...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Get your fireworks here! Get your very legal fireworks here! No need to tell the cops!
Ryan lights one of the sparklers on fire!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew!
Yesterday...
As they're about to head off to school, they see their neighbor scooping up the morning paper.
A cat comes running out.

nodes.speaker: Sparkles
nodes.text: Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Bad Sparkles! Bad! Back inside!

nodes.speaker: Sparkles
nodes.text: Mrow!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you hear that kitten's name?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow... I nudge you `a lot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... I nudge you [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd like to think that when Madame Fortuna read me my fortune, she wasn't referring to Sparkles the Kitten.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, that one might be a reach, but still, this is the time when she said you'd find love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She was wrong. Face it. You're just trying to make things fit with her prediction.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today is the last day... I don't think Nick and I are going to fall in love at Cowboy Burger in one night!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Based on our history, he's lucky we're even friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, if this were a real date...

nodes.prompt: If this were a real date...

options.label: I wouldn't ask you to come along.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If this were a real date...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you're saying that a `chocolate shop` isn't romantic?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're saying that a [color=#3b78e2][i]chocolate shop[/i][/color] isn't romantic?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Yes, it seems that that's exactly what I'm saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please explain whatever ludicrous viewpoint you have on chocolate shops.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, chocolate shops are filled with allergy catalysts. Nuts, for example.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate shops usually operate at warm, humid temperatures, making everyone in them sweaty.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And while I'm on the subject, people love chocolate, which means crowds. Annoying, consumer-filled crowds.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. Just taking the fun out of everything, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess you're the type of person who finds allergies, sweat, and long lines romantic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what you're up to Nick Brown, but fine, I'll go along with it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm... I'm on the way. I should be at your place in ten minutes. Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. See you then.
Sam hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She didn't buy any of that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If we went to places that weren't romantic, today wouldn't really be Anti-Valentine's Day. It'd just be any old day...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a good point...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In order to do Anti-Valentine's Day right, you have to do Valentine's Day stuff, but in a way that's completely platonic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like that! I just got a lot more excited for this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good. By the way, I should be at your place in ten minutes. Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. See you soon!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben seemed odd and unusually adamant about calling. I guess I could always talk to Spencer on the way over to Sam's house...
Nick texts Sam that he's running late...
He spends the next minute racing about, getting ready!
Later, on the way to Sam's house, he gets Spencer up to speed.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...And I'm supposed to call her back so I need your help quick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude! Ben's on a date with Emily... Of course he said that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Emily's probably right there next to him, drinking soda out of the same straw!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're saying Ben was compromised?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He did everything but fire a signal flare!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, uh, you dated Sam. Should I tell her that I want this to be a date?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Noooo! Do `not` do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Noooo! Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] do that!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? Is the idea that bad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you want to get your face punched or you enjoy an ice-water bath, go for it, dude! Bare your weird soul!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Cause chicks love it when guys they don't trust spring dates on them!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I see the point you're making.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good. You'll get your moment, but it isn't now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do I do until then?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only thing you can, man. You've got to push this thing you promised. You know, just be like...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Samface, we're celebrating not-Valentine's! Here's a black flower. Don't you like my sad man make-up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's listen to disco on my '90's CD player!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't really know what a hipster is, do you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No clue. But I do know that for now you have to keep how you feel about Samface in the dark.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not going to be easy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, it isn't. Deal with it.
Nick's phone buzzes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's Sam on the other line! I gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good luck. And Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you hurt her, I'll turn you into a stuffed teddy bear. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, the message was subtle, but I think I got it.
Spencer hangs up, and Nick answers Sam's call.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think I can really trust Spencer... And Ben's advice seems sound enough. I should tell her the truth.
A few minutes later, Nick is standing on the front porch of Sam's house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready for our Anti-Valentine's Day non-date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, Sam, I had to get here as soon as I could so that I could tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tell me what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I want a second chance. I know I blew it the first time, and I know I don't deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I couldn't help how I felt then, and I can't help how I feel now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I want to go out with you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! What happened to Anti-Valentine's Day?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's a lie! It's all just an excuse to spend time with you! But I couldn't go through with it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I couldn't manipulate you like that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I want to go out with you today... Tonight... Right now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On a `real` Valentine's Day date! What do you say?
nodes.text_bbcode: On a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Valentine's Day date! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. I don't want to go out with you, Nick. I was interested in Anti-Valentine's Day...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... We'll do that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I was interested in it back when it was all about us hanging out together `as friends.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I was interested in it back when it was all about us hanging out together [color=#3b78e2][i]as friends.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But not anymore?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think it would be a little awkward now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. But... But what if I hadn't said anything? If I had just gone through with the lie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Honestly, who knows what might have happened? It doesn't matter, does it? Because we'll never know.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess we'll never know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See you at school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: See ya.
Sam closes the door, and Nick trudges away, knowing full well that...
You are now playing as Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Pick up! Come on, Ben! Answer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Nick! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben! I'm in trouble, and you have a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, at the moment, yes. Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I need advice from someone with a girlfriend! I told Sam that I'd take her out on an Anti-Valentine's Day hangout...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But while I was planning it, it kind of turned into an `actual` Valentine's Day date.
nodes.text_bbcode: But while I was planning it, it kind of turned into an [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] Valentine's Day date.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How'd that happen?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know! One second I was making ironic reservations at Cowboy Burger, and the next thing I knew I had booked a table at `Les Horribles.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know! One second I was making ironic reservations at Cowboy Burger, and the next thing I knew I had booked a table at [color=#e23b3b][i]Les Horribles.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That French restaurant where everyone sings and acts sad? It's impossible to get a table there! How'd you do it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just told them I was bringing the girl my heart betrayed. They said they'd make a table for me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This sounds `way` dangerous. Can't you get out of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: This sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] dangerous. Can't you get out of it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! It's too late! I'm picking her up in like...
Nick panics as he looks at his vintage, cartoon character wrist-watch.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no! I've gotta pick her up like right now, and I'm not ready!
He scrambles to his closet, yanking his outfit down off the hanger!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Can you help me, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That depends... What exactly do you want with Sam? Do you want to be good friends? Or do you want this to be a date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I want this to be a date. But should I tell `her` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I want this to be a date. But should I tell [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben looks across the table at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want `my` advice, I'd tell the truth.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] advice, I'd tell the truth.

nodes.text: Emily nods.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem. I'm with Emily `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem. I'm with Emily [color=#e23b3b][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, `call Spencer.` Got that?
nodes.text_bbcode: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, [color=#e23b3b][i]call Spencer.[/i][/color] Got that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're sure I should tell her? Sam might flip out and--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Call. Spencer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Call. Spencer.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben hangs up. Nick starts putting on his date outfit.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do I really want to call Spencer? He and Sam used to date, and I've gotta pick her up in like... Negative two minutes!

options.label: Follow Ben's advice and tell Sam the truth.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel like both of us are starting to get upset.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sometimes it's good to take a step back.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess so. I wouldn't want to say something I'd regret.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Exactly. I was one second away from insulting your mother.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. Answer the phone already.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nick would only call me if something was really wrong.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess the person who never calls you is more important than the person who calls you `every` day.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess the person who never calls you is more important than the person who calls you [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Whatever. Just answer the phone already.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Listen, can I call you back?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Suuuuure.
Nick hangs up and frantically makes a call...
You are now playing as Ben...
Meanwhile, Ben and Emily are having a Valentine's Day date of their own in the park.
Fancy tea cups are set up between them on a table beneath the park's gazebo.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think? Not a bad date, right? Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, Colonel Insecure. Relax, would you? I'm having a great time!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How could I not when there are crumpets to eat?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess I wanted to make sure we were still good after our fight about, you know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me becoming your dad's BFF because my dad is never around.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Of course we're good!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But when did we get so deep?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Are you going to talk to him?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. No, silly. I was talking about yours.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why would I talk to my dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How about the fact that there's obviously a huge, elephant-sized issue between the two of you?!
Ben's phone rings. He checks and sees that it's Nick.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you really going to take that call in the middle of this discussion?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, but only because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a chocolate shop'?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a fancy restaurant'?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out on the town?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yup. Out... On the town!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, that sounds nice!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it also sounds like we're about to start a Broadway musical number.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Could I get a little bit more from you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... A chocolate shop?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a chocolate shop'?!

nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick

nodes.text: He finds an empty street, no trace of Sam anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She... She got away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't get a chance to explain to her how I feel.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And now...
Nick hangs his head and turns back toward the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now it'll be completely awkward at school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Any chance I had to be more than friends just disappeared...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Along with a chance of even being friends.
It's pretty clear...
Inside, he discovers a quiet, darkened room.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam? You in here?
Nick creeps forward, hoping his eyes will adjust.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't see a thing...
His foot slips off a small ledge!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ack!
`Sploosh!` His leg is suddenly knee-deep in water!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Sploosh![/b] His leg is suddenly knee-deep in water!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What the! Where am I?
Nick reaches the edge of the water and climbs up onto a ledge. Unseen hands pull him up to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You caught me. Now what?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam! Where are we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind that! You lied to me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I did.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?!
Sam grabs him by the shirt, threatening to dump him back into the water.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! I was worried that if we really went through with Anti-Valentine's Day, you'd think we were friends and nothing more.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'd be stuck, you know, in--
Sam lets him go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In the friendzone?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. What was I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about just ask me out on a date?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would you have said yes? Honestly?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So then it didn't matter what I did... At least this way I tried!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean `you lied!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean [color=#3b78e2][i]you lied![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which we just established was the only way you'd go out with me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So tonight `was` a date then?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So tonight [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a date then?!

nodes.text: Nick sighs...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Date. Not a date. I don't know... I think the real question is which did you want it to be?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because I know `exactly` what I wanted tonight to be, Sam... Do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I know [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what I wanted tonight to be, Sam... Do you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... That... That's not important!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Come on, Sam. Why'd you even sit down with me at the restaurant tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I sat down because... Because you asked me! Because...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The Sam I know would never do that unless she thought that we actually have something... Something real.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Something new this time around, something special...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what's that?
A voice calls out in the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Give it a shot now, Earl, I think the power's back on!
Nick and Sam are standing on a maintenance platform beneath a sign that says `Tunnel of Love`. Around them is a flowing river with several boats stranded in the water.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nick and Sam are standing on a maintenance platform beneath a sign that says [b]Tunnel of Love[/b]. Around them is a flowing river with several boats stranded in the water.

nodes.text: Each boat has an electric lead, a long pole that rubs flush with a mesh of metal overhead. Sparks burst from each lead, blooming like flowery fireworks and raining down all around Nick and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, what we have... `Is a spark.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, what we have... [color=#e23b3b][i]Is a spark.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's... There's no way you could have planned this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't!
A voice calls out from one of the boats...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo hipster, kiss her already!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How is Sam going to kiss herself, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm talking to Nick...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, duh! Kiss her, hot guy!
As the sparks continue to burst around them, Nick leans in and kisses Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like Madame Fortuna's fortune came true.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You knew about it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... I know about the one she gave me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Oh, of course. What was it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That I'd find love doing what I love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, isn't 'what you love' photography?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I love most is spending time with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Okay, that was pretty smooth.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How could I not love spending time with you with this new perfume you're wearing?!
Sam blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You smell like jasmine... Have you been wearing it all night?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I put it on when I went to the restroom. Can you do me a favor?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't mention the perfume to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. Question for you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you hungry?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Starving. I'm really regretting running out before the entree got there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Want to go to Cowboy Burger?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick Brown, are you asking me out on a date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I am, Sam. I am.

Nick runs in front of the carriage! The horse stops, neighing!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You crazy hooligan! What do you think you're doing? You almost made me spill hot cocoa on my girl here!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: It's okay, Monte Carlos! Forget about him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If you say so, my dear! I guess it is Valentine's... And only on a day like today could you make me forget about enforcing discipline and order!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: And you make me forget that I'm not a young schoolgirl anymore! Let's neck!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Neck?! Is that even a verb? What does that even--?!
Nick is unable to look away in time...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh! Wrong!
He runs away as fast as he can! When he passes the carriage...
The carriage trots in front of him, blocking his path.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam's getting away!
Nick runs around the back of the carriage and...
Nick hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like I'm waiting here...
Nick steps on a piece of chocolate, his feet start to slip...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoop!
...But he regains his balance, as he leaps toward another patch of open concrete...
Only to watch in horror as a chocolate candy rolls into the space his foot is heading!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh oh!
His foot lands squarely on the chocolate and slides out from under him, sending his body flying through the air!
He crashes down on his back a split second later!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam! I'm sorry about the note!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just reassure me that you didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I did!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't! Maybe I went too far with the spirit of Anti-Valentine's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... So, what's next?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Dinner, if you're still up for it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am. I'm starving! Where do we go for Anti-Valentine's Day? Cowboy Burger?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet no one's there!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Just promise me you'll keep an open mind...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick... Where are we having dinner?
A few minutes later, Nick and Sam walk into `Les Horribles.` In the main room, a violinist plays a beautiful melody before a vast fireplace.
nodes.text_bbcode: A few minutes later, Nick and Sam walk into [b]Les Horribles.[/b] In the main room, a violinist plays a beautiful melody before a vast fireplace.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?
Nick checks in with the host.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Monsieur Nick, Mademoiselle Samantha... With great pain, I show you to your table.
The host seats them at a candlelit table with a white tablecloth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm trying `real` hard to keep an open mind here, Nick. But this feels like the datiest date of all time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm trying [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] hard to keep an open mind here, Nick. But this feels like the datiest date of all time!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know it looks bad, but, uh... Uh, hold on, one second, okay? Gotta use the little hipsters' room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. Go. But I'm sure someone's already using it.
Nick races into the restroom and calls Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Pick up! Pick up! Pick up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it, Brown?! Did you hurt Sam?! I will hunt you down, I swear--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, I didn't! Honest!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did she find out?! Did you blab, dummy?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! But she's onto me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: At any moment she's going to know for sure this is a date, and then I'm dead!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wish I could slap you through the phone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get a grip!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sooner or later, I'm going to have to tell her, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, and this is not the time! You can't tell her it's a date `before` you have the date!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and this is not the time! You can't tell her it's a date [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] you have the date!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You have to woo, man! Woo first, `then` tell her. That's the whole point!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to woo, man! Woo first, [color=#e23b3b][i]then[/i][/color] tell her. That's the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's going to be upset either way. But if she has a fun time with you first, you might just have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I can do this. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No problem. Oh, one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you hurt her, I'll rip out your heart and serve it at a party as candy. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Subtler than last time, but I think I caught the gist.
Nick returns to the table.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, I bet you're wondering how we're going to make `this` Anti-Valentine's, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I bet you're wondering how we're going to make [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] Anti-Valentine's, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You hit the nail on the head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was thinking we could...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you're good company.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not so bad yourself, Monsieur Brown.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Careful, you might insult them for saying that with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... There's something I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: First off, I think that you're...
Nick sees a delivery man at the front of the restaurant holding a huge bouquet of roses!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...Crap!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... No not that you're crap, just that, uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't believe I forgot about the roses! In thirty seconds, she's going to know how I feel! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ruined suits aside...
As Nick finally nears...
Sam reaches into her purse...
And hurls a bunch of brown objects behind her! As Nick approaches, he sees them bouncing on the sidewalk!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are those?
Realization dawns on him...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate traps!
Chocolate pieces bounce along the sidewalk before him!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Every one of them's a potential twisted ankle!
He runs into the chocolate mine field, trying not to step on any!
Sam is now just a hundred yards away!
